title: Cordell Jacks is handing out copies to fellow investors — financial gravity 'gets to the heart of why we've chosen a different path'
summary: Jacks is CEO and general partner of Regenerative Capital Group, which runs as a permanent holding company instead of a fund with an exit horizon. He wrote that he has been giving copies of Incorruptible to friends, colleagues and fellow investors, and sets the book's account of financial gravity against decades of impact investing, B Corps and the SDGs that left ownership, governance and capital structures unchanged.
blockquote: His exploration of financial gravity—the structural forces that pull enterprises toward short-term extraction—gets to the heart of why we've chosen a different path at RCG.
